title: Member-Opened Exception Requests under the Formulary Benefit
content:
Under the Formulary Benefit, a member may open an exception request on their own behalf. When they do, the request's priority (standard or expedited) is set from the member's records. The days of the drug the member has left are compared with the days the member would wait for a standard decision. A request that a member opens still needs the prescriber's supporting statement.

## The member's own tool: `submit_member_exception_request_38483004`

**Capability.** One call opens one new exception case for one drug in the member's exception history, under the member's formulary assignment. The case is received at that moment and marked as opened by the member. It names the prescriber who will be asked for the supporting statement and carries the priority given. It then shows as an open request whenever the member's exception history is looked up. The tool makes this single write and checks nothing about eligibility or the value given.

**How it is invoked.** This tool belongs to the member. The agent unlocks `submit_member_exception_request_38483004` and hands it over, and the customer themselves (the member) runs it to submit the request.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `formulary_assignment_id` | reference number of the member's formulary assignment, as read out to the member from the formulary assignment lookup | identifier |
| `customer_id` | the member's own customer reference number, as read out to the member from the customer profile lookup | identifier |
| `drug_name` | the drug the exception is requested for | exactly one drug master list name: atorvastatin, lisinopril, metformin, sertraline, levothyroxine, sumatriptan, oxycodone-acetaminophen, insulin glargine-yfgn, Lantus, Eliquis, Xarelto, Jardiance, Ozempic, Mounjaro, Wegovy, Zepbound, Trelegy Ellipta, Breztri Aerosphere, Nurtec ODT, Ubrelvy, Humira, adalimumab-adaz, Dupixent, Skyrizi, Rinvoq, Enbrel, Biktarvy, Ibrance |
| `drug_strength` | the strength and dosage form prescribed, copied character for character from the strength on the member's latest prescription for the drug as read out to the member | verbatim text |
| `exception_type` | `tier_exception` (the drug is on the formulary and the member asks for it at a lower cost-share tier) or `non_formulary_exception` (the drug is coded non-formulary and the member asks for it to be covered) | enum |
| `prescriber_npi` | National Provider Identifier of the prescriber who will be asked for the supporting statement | 10 digits, no spaces or punctuation |
| `review_priority` | `standard` (decided on the standard timeframe) or `expedited` (decided on the expedited timeframe) | enum |

A parameter's presence means only that the value is needed when the tool is run.

**Return.** The receipt carries:
- `formulary_exception_id`, the new request's reference number;
- `drug_name`;
- `exception_type`;
- `review_priority`, the priority recorded;
- `requested_by`, which is always member for this tool;
- `received_at`, the moment of receipt on the system clock;
- status "received".

Status "received" means the request was submitted. No other outcome is defined.
